title: A simpler view: hold the price fixed

steps.title: Hold the price still
steps.say: Forget the whole curve for a moment. Keep the price fixed at P1 and look across the dashed line.

ops.text: Same price P1, but more people want the product.

steps.title: More wanted at P1
steps.say: At the price P1, buyers now want Q2 instead of Q1. The demand curve has moved right.

steps.title: Shift vs. move along
steps.say: A shift right means more is wanted at every price. A change in price only moves you along the curve.

ops.text:
Shift right = more wanted at EVERY price.
Price change alone = moving ALONG the curve.
